text:
Gold Price in 2019
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2019, the LBMA gold price rose 14.5% between 2019-01-31 ($1,323) and 2019-12-30 ($1,515). The highest sampled price was $1,528 in August and the lowest was $1,282 in April. The mean of these observations was $1,404. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
